hero.title: Let's build something together
hero.body: Whether you are opening a wholesale account, exploring distribution, or looking for clinical-grade recommendations, our B2B team is ready to help.

retailer.title: Retailer
retailer.description: Open a wholesale account to carry Sliquid, RIDE Lube, and Ride Rocco in-store or online. Access merchandising assets, planogram support, and competitive wholesale pricing tiers.

media.title: Marketing & Media
media.description: Press inquiries, brand collaborations, influencer partnerships, and editorial requests. Reach out with your media kit or proposal and our marketing team will follow up.

distributor.title: Distributor
distributor.description: We work with regional and global distribution partners to expand access in markets where direct fulfillment is not available. Tell us about your territory and logistics capabilities.

medical.title: Medical Professionals
medical.description: We partner with physicians, pelvic floor therapists, OB-GYNs, sex therapists, and other licensed healthcare providers who recommend intimate wellness products to their patients. Reach out to learn about our Medical Partners Program.

review.title: We review your inquiry
review.detail: Our B2B team reads every message and will match your inquiry to the right person in sales, distribution, or clinical partnerships.

reply.title: You hear back within 2 business days
reply.detail: We will reach out by email (or phone if you provided a number) to discuss your needs and next steps.

proposal.title: We send a tailored proposal
proposal.detail: Depending on your inquiry type, you will receive a wholesale pricing sheet, distributor agreement, or clinical partner overview.

onboarding.title: Onboarding & support
onboarding.detail: Once a partnership is confirmed, your dedicated account contact provides product training, asset kits, and ongoing support.
